articles.summary: ARCHBOLD, Ohio, Dec. 17, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- F&M Bank (“F&M”), an Archbold, Ohio-based bank owned by Farmers & Merchants Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq: FMAO), is pleased to announce the promotion of Mike Schnitkey to Agri-Finance and Northwest Ohio Market President.
